name: Hinged Box With Latch, Somewhat Parametric and Printable In One Piece

captions.detailed: This 3D model is a print-in-place, one-piece hinged box shown in its fully open position. It consists of two symmetrical rectangular compartments connected by a central interlocking barrel hinge. The front side of one compartment features a small indented latch cutout, while the corresponding side of the opposite compartment includes an integrated vertical latch tab with a small cylindrical locking ridge designed to snap-fit shut.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric, print-in-place hinged box with a rectangular body, an integrated interlocking barrel hinge, and a snap-fit latch. The script should include parameters for the box width, depth, height, wall thickness, hinge outer/inner diameters, and clearances (slop) to ensure the hinge prints cleanly as a single piece.
captions.factory: The design is split into two main modules, 'bottom()' and 'top()', representing the two halves of the box. Each half is constructed using a 'difference' operation between a larger outer 'cube' and a smaller inner 'cube' to form the hollow compartment with a defined wall thickness. The interlocking hinge is built using a 'hull' operation combining cylinders and cubes, with alternating segments carved out using a 'for' loop and 'cube' subtraction to create the interlocking fingers. A central pin cylinder is integrated into the bottom module, while a matching cylindrical cutout is subtracted from the top module with a clearance slop parameter.
